notes.title: Next Major Update Coming In April & Update On The Roadmap!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers, 

The 3rd major update is currently under development and will come in next month, April!

With 2 major updates already released, we have decided to rearrange our roadmap a little bit and release the 2nd community update before the last faction update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43140540/b10ff5d0a83eb8d5cee1284b411d91dae5a6819a.png[/img]

The next major update is going to be a community update and will focus on improving existing contents. There will be new contents as well such as a new companion to unlock, new skills and new equipment. Moreover, we are bringing steam achievements to [i]Dungeon Dungeon![/i] in the next update! So stay tuned!

As always, there will be a detailed list of changes and new content when the update comes out!

Kamen Yamada

tags.feature: - There will be new contents as well such as a new companion to unlock, new skills and new equipment.
- Moreover, we are bringing steam achievements to [i]Dungeon Dungeon![/i] in the next update!

notes.title: Welcome Adventurers!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone

We have just announced [i]Dungeon Dungeon![/i] a few days ago, and it is great to see a lot of people showing interest.

You have probably read the description on the store page already. But here we want to show you more about the game and share some exciting screenshots and GIFs!

[h2]What to expect in [i]Dungeon Dungeon![/i] [/h2]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/WWxdX1p/combat-Gif-0.gif[/img]
[h3]Turn-based Combat[/h3]
[i]Dungeon Dungeon![/i] features a unique turn-based combat system. You will be able to change the unit's orders to take turns. Utilize the effect of skills, passives and equipment to delay the enemies or hasten your companions to exploit the weakness of the enemies and protect your companions.

Furthermore, by combining with the [b]combo system[/b], you can create a rampage of attacks to crush the enemies, or save your team from a seemingly certain defeat.

[h3]Party-based RPG[/h3]
At the Early Access Release, there will be 6 companions in the game, each with unique initial skill and passives. There will also be unique permanent perks for each of the companions for you to unlock. [b]More companions[/b] are to come with the updates during the EA period.

By defeating enemies and completing quests, companions gain experiences to level up. You will be able to choose new skills, upgrade existing skills, increase attributes, and choose adventurer classes for your companions. 
[img]https://i.ibb.co/ScM90P2/screenshot-0.png[/img]
[h3]High Replayability[/h3]
Having roguelike elements in the game, we aim to provide high replayability in [i]Dungeon Dungeon![/i]. Every playthrough will be different. You will encounter different enemies in different factions. You will have different skills to choose from. And naturally we would have a good variety of enemies, skills, equipment so that players would not get bored quickly.

With our unique combat system and the amount of skills and passives, there is a possibility for all kinds of different builds. We encourage you to try different play styles, different ways to develop companions and build your party. 

[h2]What happens now till the EA release[/h2]
[i]Dungeon Dungeon![/i] is very much still in development. We are focusing on adding more contents, balancing and bug fixing to ensure that players would have the best gameplay experience when the game is released. We are also looking into the possibility to participate in [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] in February 2023 and have a [b]demo[/b] for everyone to try there. More info will come in the future if this is going to happen, so stay tuned!

[b]Follow our twitter![/b] https://twitter.com/DungeonNDungeon
[b]We post more about our game on twitter weekly.[/b]

Join our Discord Server! https://discord.gg/xEQtNZFHb2

Cheers!
Kamen Yamada
